messages:
Noah Patel: Morning! Noah here, joined Platform today. Quick security/onboarding ping: my laptop shows up tomorrow but I want to get a head start. 1) Is the phishing sim mandatory during first week? 2) Can I pre-enroll my personal dev laptop in a limited MDM profile while I wait for the company machine? 3) Where do I check device encryption status on macOS?

Zoe (People Ops): welcome Noah :wave: Phish sims are standard but we do exemption/loaner flow if you don't have a managed device yet. Please finish Security Basics in the learning portal within 72h. We prefer you use a company device, but temporary options exist.

Dmitri IT: @Noah - we don't enroll personal devices fully. If you want to use a personal device temporarily, we can create a "managed-limited" policy that only applies necessary hardening (disk encryption + screen lock) without corporate certs. To check encryption: open Terminal -> `fdesetup status`. If it says "On", you're encrypted. If "Off", enable via System Preferences > Security & Privacy > FileVault > Turn On.

Noah Patel: fdesetup returned: "FileVault is Off". I can enable tonight. For the limited policy, is there any risk to personal data?

Dmitri IT: The limited policy only pushes system settings and a lightweight MDM profile; it does not touch personal files. We won't install enterprise VPNs or SSO profiles on personal devices. If you'd rather not enroll, request a loaner from Facilities.

Jules InfoSec: Also note: MFA enrollment is independent of device. Please complete identity enrollment ASAP. For phish sims: if you're on a managed device or loaner you'll be included; if not, reply with "loaner-request" and we'll postpone your cohort.

PhishSimBot: User Noah Patel scheduled for phishing cohort on 2026-02-10. Reply with "loaner-request" to be exempt until managed device is assigned.

Noah Patel: Thanks, will enable FileVault and enroll in the limited policy. Also did Security Basics earlier this morning. One more Q: any recommended authenticator app?

Terry Eng: I use Authy for backups, but we recommend using Google Authenticator or 1Password integrated MFA if you want hardware key fallback. YubiKeys are supported for production accounts.

Zoe (People Ops): added you to the onboarding tracker and requested a loaner hold just in case delivery fails. Welcome aboard again! :tada:

Noah Patel: Appreciate the quick help. FileVault on now, saw the Jamf invite pop up. I'll finish MFA next.
